comments.body: Exact-head check at edcf770a (Claude lab): `rustfmt --check --edition 2021` clean on chat-grade.rs; `cargo test --release -p uor-r4-training --bin chat-grade` 16 passed; `chat-grade check` on v4-a+b with the ladder tokenizer, context 384: `check_panel: pass`, binding swap 0/40, expected value 40/40, echo 0/40, constants 0/0/0 (memory) and 24/0/0 (unknowable), copy-first/last 19/20 of 40, worst-case history 347 positions; novelty script exit 0. Note for acceptance design: the copy controls pass ~half the memory rows, so a Step 6c bar must sit well above 20/40. Approve at this head.
